title.narrative: Improving sanitation services for IDPs and host communities in Marib, Yemen

description.narrative: Construction of new toilets Repair and rehabilitation of septic tanks Provision of basic equipment to support local waste management services (solid waste collection and sanitation) and improvement of sanitary landfills Solid waste collection Technical support for water, sanitation and hygiene operations

Implement rapid construction of toilets, conduct solid waste collection and rehabilitate and/or repair septic tanks. In parallel, exit strategies are supported by providing basic equipment to the Housing Fund, and strengthening local capacity to provide continuous waste collection services in the long term.
Improving the living conditions of IDPs and affected populations by restoring access to safe and dignified sanitation services.
